name: 45431 · Beavercreek, OH
findings: ZIP 45431 (Beavercreek) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45431 (Beavercreek) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45431 (Beavercreek) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
